target: ClayVerse single-container concurrency and canonical-state coherence

hypotheses.mechanism: Remove broad cognition/session fencing from append-only knowledge updates; retain strict fencing only for effects and nonmonotone state transitions.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: session generation is a cheap universal safety guard
hypotheses.falsifier: concurrent stale resolve/retract must never commit without a narrower fence
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: generation is session-scoped and not operation-polarity-scoped

hypotheses.mechanism: Hash exact positive and negative context predicates used by a turn; validate before commit.
hypotheses.counterprediction: candidate collapses to known OCC/predicate validation
hypotheses.falsifier: prior-art equivalence plus no Clay-specific gain
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: resource refs are collision hints, not exact read predicates

hypotheses.mechanism: Track turn-level rw-dependency edges and abort only dangerous cycles.
hypotheses.falsifier: cycle detector misses modeled write skew or exceeds fixed resource budget
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: causal episodes do not encode database rw conflict graphs

hypotheses.mechanism: Acquire a canonical resource lease for every inferred resource before any turn commits.
hypotheses.falsifier: high false-coordination rate on append-only workload

hypotheses.mechanism: Every context read receives a short causal epoch; commit succeeds only if affected scopes remain epoch-compatible.
hypotheses.falsifier: false aborts dominate under append-heavy dual sessions
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: session generation is not bound to assembled context dependencies

hypotheses.mechanism: Classify canonical state transitions by information polarity: immutable contradiction-preserving claim appends commute; resolve/retract/absence/effects/unknown cross a validated antimonotone aperture.
hypotheses.problem_target: preserve one shared entity under dual-session concurrency without global serialization
hypotheses.expected_gain: coordinate only where information can be destroyed, collapsed, assumed absent, or externalized
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: OCC context witness for all same-resource operations
hypotheses.counterprediction: polarity typing is unsafe or too difficult to classify
hypotheses.falsifier: any monotone-classified operation can invalidate prior canonical information or effect state
hypotheses.minimum_test: typed pairwise discriminator plus misclassification ablation
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: current schema stores durable memories/turns but has no typed append-vs-collapse semantic boundary

hypotheses.mechanism: Represent knowledge as join-semilattice claim atoms and explicit contest edges; resolved answers are derived views.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: ordinary append-only event log plus resolver
hypotheses.counterprediction: lattice adds structure without measurable gain
hypotheses.falsifier: event-log baseline preserves the same information with lower cost
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: durable_memory is value rows without explicit contest topology

hypotheses.mechanism: Allow assistant responses as provisional branches; promote only after context/effect validation.
hypotheses.problem_target: long cognition latency under changing state
hypotheses.counterprediction: users observe provisional contradictions and complexity rises
hypotheses.falsifier: promotion/retraction UX or causal lineage cannot remain exact
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Stop currently commits assistant turn directly

hypotheses.mechanism: Record fine-grained dependency graph from context fragments to answer/effect intents and invalidate only affected computations.
hypotheses.counterprediction: LLM reasoning dependencies are not reliably observable
hypotheses.falsifier: hidden dependency mutations alter result without graph invalidation
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: context assembly records inputs, not causal use of each input

hypotheses.mechanism: Append claims freely, but require prepare/validate/commit for any transition that collapses alternatives.
hypotheses.counterprediction: extra phase is unnecessary inside one DB
hypotheses.falsifier: no concurrency benefit versus one transaction

hypotheses.mechanism: Treat assumptions of absence/uniqueness as explicit capabilities that require validated negative predicates.
hypotheses.counterprediction: too many natural-language decisions cannot be typed
hypotheses.falsifier: important absence-dependent operations evade the type boundary
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: resource inference captures named positives, not negative predicates

hypotheses.mechanism: When Gabriel and Andreas append conflicting claims, preserve both as perspective-bound evidence and create a shared contest object; never auto-vote or overwrite.
hypotheses.problem_target: one entity with equal user perspectives
hypotheses.counterprediction: perspective metadata becomes a hidden second authority
hypotheses.falsifier: same semantic claim resolves differently solely by user identity without explicit policy
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: users are equal sessions but durable_memory has no explicit contest object

selection.reason: best current combination of product leverage, falsifiability, architecture compression and sparse-region mechanism departure while preserving strict effect authority
selection.rejection_reason: useful conventional baseline but collapses strongly to OCC/predicate-validation prior art
